reason: PURE. First thing I saw was the QR on the box and every sachet with a named ISO 17025 lab, because that is the kind of proof I look for instead of taking claims on faith. The sachets also fit my travel weeks, so I would try one box, but only after opening a batch report to check it is real.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal, so the lab report is only the brand's own say-so until I see a real batch report. Also the 200 mg is two capsules of 100 mg, which is fine but I want to see that on the label, not just the front.
would_change_my_mind: A QR report that opens to a real, batch-specific result from the named lab, or NSF/USP certification, would make me reorder. A dead link or generic PDF would make it a no.
